Application Procedures
Application Fees
Application Fees
The Graduate College non-refundable application fees are listed below.
All Graduate Applicants
Non-Degree Seeking, $45.00 *
Degree Seeking, $90.00
Certificate, $90.00 (Application fee is waived for currently enrolled University of Arizona graduate degree seeking students.)
Graduate Exchange Programs, $90.00 (Contact the Study Abroad office to check eligibility.)
* International Non-Degree Seeking applicants must hold an eligible US Visa. Please verify eligibility with the ISS office before submitting an application. Current F1, J1, and B1/B2 visa holders do not qualify for non-degree seeking admission.
Use of our online system is the only method of application. When applying to multiple graduate programs, applicants must submit a separate application and fee for each program. Acceptable forms of payment are Visa, MasterCard, and American Express.
The Graduate College does not waive application fees. General email requests for an application fee waiver will not be considered.
Application fees are non-refundable.
